verdicts.reason: A: the title keeps its prominence, but the body copy wraps raggedly into one-word lines ('LIVONIA', 'LIAM DRAKE'), the dates break unevenly onto two lines, the cross and 'Worship' block sit on a slightly different left axis, a large dead gap is left above the shrunken hiker illustration, and the key image is reduced to a token strip. B: the small cross is blown up into a huge, blurry, pixelated shape that becomes the dominant focal point, which wrecks the hierarchy and the fidelity. It also has a bad 'PASTOR LIAM / DRAKE' break and the same tiny illustration jammed at the bottom, so it is worse than A.
